# Vendored libraries

`3d-force-graph.min.js` — v1.80.0 by Vasco Asturiano, MIT licensed.
https://github.com/vasturiano/3d-force-graph

It is checked in so the galaxy renders with no network access at all. The viewer
loads this local copy first and falls back to a CDN if it is missing, so you can
delete it if you would rather pull from a CDN.
